row.notes: martinus robin_hood Table::rehashPowerOfTwo for the GVDB value map (its only two callers: the load's reserve 0x1445a0aa3 and Gdb_HashMap_Insert's growth 0x1445a1325). num_buckets must be a power of two >= 8: sets mask=num_buckets-1, max_num_elements_allowed=num_buckets*80/100, count=0, info_inc=0x20, allocates (num_buckets+min(max,0xff))*17+8 bytes from map->allocator vt+0x10 (slots 16 B each, then info bytes; null -> fatal 0x1403139f0), then re-inserts every old slot. GAME BUG: each moved slot is copied (0x1445a6bd1..0x1445a6bd6) and then the old record is destroyed (record vt+8, flag 0, 0x1445a6c09) and freed through g_Gdb_RecordAllocator vt+0x38 (0x1445a6c1b), so after a rehash of a map that holds records every slot points at freed memory. Safe only on the empty map (count 0, mask 0: the old storage is the inline &mask dummy, nothing moved or freed). Old storage freed through map->allocator vt+0x38 unless it is the dummy
